_note: The plugin's repository is wcgwhq/standup. While it is private the commands below fail for everyone else, so ui.installNote stays until it is public. One command per agent; {repo} is filled in from `repo`. Each command is that agent's own install route, read from its CLI help on 2026-11-12: Codex and Grok accept the repository's Claude-format manifest (checked with `codex plugin marketplace add` on the local folder and `grok plugin validate`), Gemini CLI loads it as an extension (`gemini-extension.json`, checked with `gemini extensions link`). Cursor's manifest (.cursor-plugin/) follows its docs and has not been run. opencode has no plugin route for skills, so it copies the two folders. Since 2026-11-16 the plugin sits in plugin/ of the one Standup repository: the marketplace files at the repository root point at it, Gemini's manifest is at the root with a skills link, and Grok installs the subfolder with #plugin. `slug` is the agent's own page on the site (src/pages/[...locale]/[agent].astro); an agent without one has no page.

agents.name: Codex
agents.command: codex plugin marketplace add {repo} && codex plugin add standup@standup
